text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Satsuki Sho. Biwa Hayahide 
was fired up to compete against fierce 
rivals like Narita Taishin and Winning 
Ticket.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Narita Taishin is still 
irritated that people keep assuming she is 
at a disadvantage just because of her 
small build.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before the race, Biwa Hayahide spotted 
Narita Taishin and tried to call out to 
her, but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wearing a ghastly, intense expression, 
Narita Taishin walked away from the spot 
without saying a word.
